longDescription: Sport Board displays the football match nearest to the current time for a team assigned to each Ulanzi D200 key. Select a competition and team, then view home and away crests, team names, kickoff time, score, and match date directly on the device. Match-day information refreshes every two minutes until the fixture reaches a terminal state, and pressing the key triggers a manual refresh. A football-data.org API token is required, and competition and fixture availability depends on the account plan.
